title: arabis cebennensis subsp. pedemontana
intro: Arabis cebennensis subsp. pedemontana, commonly known as Mountain Rockcress, is a plant species in the family Brassicaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. Arabis cebennensis subsp. pedemontana is reported to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
